title: 本大爷乃是第一章！
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

祝予现在像漂浮在马桶里的大便一样无助。

她还记得自己上一秒

明明是熟悉的街道，却有着截然不同的街景，路人的穿着跟神态，让她产生了一种在看二十年前电影的不真实感。

【欢迎来到2010年的抚玉镇】

在她愣神之际，脑中呲呲电流声划过，紧接着一个空洞的声音突兀在脑中响起。

祝予下意识问：“你谁？”

【先不急着解释，你身后有东西】

祝予颇为淡定地回应：“屁眼呗，每个人身后都有。”

“转校生是吧，怎么来这么晚。”

刚讲完屁眼论，身后便响起一道人声，让祝予陷入了一瞬诡异的沉默，紧接着她缓缓转身。

一个穿着蓝白运动校服的男生站在她身后。

祝予盯着他校服外套上那行‘南明中学’的小字看了一会儿，黑沉的眸中闪过瞬间诧异。

听到男生询问她怎么了，也只是有些心不在焉地敷衍道：“没事儿，认错屁眼了。”

男生：“………？”

他咳嗽了一声，努力让自己的表情看起来没有那么扭曲：“祝予吗，本来是班主任来接你的，但他刚才吃坏了肚子。”

“我是二班的班长，来接你去报到。”

他说着，还嘟囔了句高三转学可不多见，同时打量起祝予的模样。

很怪的水母头，短发却又留着几缕长发垂在两侧肩膀上，体型消瘦、皮肤苍白，整个人郁色很重，看起来不太健康。

长相倒是很漂亮，瓜子脸，眼睛很大，眼珠黑白分明的，要是能笑一笑肯定很好看。

不过……不知道为什么，他总觉得这张脸很眼熟是怎么回事儿？

祝予没注意他的眼神，她习惯性地微低下头走路，齐刘海遮掩住她放空的眼神，回忆着刚才在脑中听到的声音。

2010年？

意思是，她从2034年回到了2010年？

祝予第一想法是智能马桶现在应该普及了吧，她蹲坑蹲不住啊。

【………不如想点其他的？】

【你对妈妈这个角色有什么看法吗？】

空洞的声音再次在脑中响起。

听到这句话，祝予地脚步顿了一下，敛眸沉思一会儿。

看她这表情，那道声音稍微欣慰了一下，暗自窃喜祝予终于发现重点！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhu Yu is now as helpless as a piece of shit floating in the toilet.

She still remembers her last second

It was obviously a familiar street, but it had a completely different street scene. The clothes and demeanor of passers-by gave her an unreal feeling as if she was watching a movie twenty years ago.

[Welcome to Fuyu Town in 2010]

While she was dazed, a buzzing sound of electricity flashed through her head, and then a hollow voice suddenly sounded in her head.

Zhu Yu subconsciously asked: "Who are you?"

[Don’t rush to explain, there is something behind you]

Zhu Yu responded calmly: "There's an asshole, there's one behind everyone."

"You're a transfer student, right? Why are you here so late?"

As soon as she finished talking about the butthole theory, a voice sounded from behind her, causing Zhu Yu to fall into a strange silence for a moment, and then she turned around slowly.

A boy wearing a blue and white sports uniform stood behind her.

Zhu Yu stared at the small words "Nanming Middle School" on his school uniform jacket for a while, and a moment of surprise flashed in his dark eyes.

When the boy asked her what was wrong, he just said in a perfunctory manner: "It's okay, I got the wrong asshole."

Boy: “…?”

He coughed and tried to keep his expression from looking so distorted: "Zhu Yu, it was the head teacher who came to pick you up, but he just had a bad stomach."

"I'm the monitor of Class 2. I'm here to pick you up and report."

As he spoke, he muttered that it was rare for him to transfer to another school in his senior year of high school, and at the same time he looked at Zhu Yu's appearance.

He has a very strange jellyfish head, with short hair but a few strands of long hair hanging down on both sides of his shoulders. He is thin, has pale skin, and his whole body is very gloomy, and he looks unhealthy.

She looks very beautiful, with a oval face and big eyes, black and white. She would look good if she could smile.

But... I don't know why, but he always feels that this face looks familiar. Why?

Zhu Yu didn't pay attention to his eyes. She walked with her head slightly lowered as a habit, her bangs covering her vacant eyes, recalling the voice she just heard in her head.

2010?

Meaning, she went back to 2010 from 2034?

Zhu Yu's first thought was that smart toilets should be common by now. She couldn't stand squatting.

【……How about thinking of something else?】

[What do you think of the role of mother?】

The hollow voice sounded in my head again.

Upon hearing these words, Zhu Yudi paused and closed his eyes in thought for a while.

Seeing her expression, the voice felt a little relieved, and secretly rejoiced that I finally found the point!
